member.name: M:Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ConfigurationExtensions.RegisterNamedHayatePool``1(DotNetCore.HayateOP.IHayateServiceCollection,Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Registers a named pool of type driven by configuration: the configuration-driven counterpart of AddNamedPool<T>(name).
member.param: The configuration root used to read pool options.
The logical pool name; also the name of the per-pool configuration section ({configSectionPath}:Pools:{name}).
member.exception: Thrown when the merged pool configuration is invalid.
member.remarks: The pool is registered under the canonical name {typeof(T).Name}:{name} and resolved through , so a configuration-driven named pool coexists with the unnamed pool of the same type and with any other name — exactly as a pool declared with AddNamedPool does. Section merging and hot reload behave as they do for : the global section is applied first and only the keys present in the pool's own section override it.
